law: EVERY operator surface — any dashboard, any line/frontier view, any console or chat meant for the creator — MUST render through the shared SOCC canon renderer. No line invents its own operator style. The creator sees ONE style, everywhere.

mechanism.cli: socc_cli/style.py (already the single CLI style source)
mechanism.html: SYSTEM/INTERFACE/dashboard/socc_canon_html.py (the web analogue — import it; never hand-roll palette/badges/headers)
mechanism.unified_pult: SYSTEM/INTERFACE/dashboard/socc_console.py -> SYSTEM/DASHBOARD/SOCC_CONSOLE.html (renders ALL panels + Brand Forge as sections)

how_any_line_complies: emit STATE as a JSON panel in SYSTEM/DASHBOARD/ (id/status/stage/current/next/truth_boundary) — it auto-appears in the console
OR for a custom view: import socc_canon_html and use palette()/page()/divider()/badge()/dot()/row()
NEVER write bespoke colors/fonts for an operator screen

two_tiers.operator: this law — SOCC canon (matrix), one style for the creator
two_tiers.product: the entity's own brand (ANNA D3, Марк, …) — the customer NEVER sees the matrix style

shared_invariants_both_tiers: voice-law (calm, precise, honest, no hype, no fake PASS)
enforcement: Any new operator HTML that does NOT import socc_canon_html (or render via the console) is a canon violation — re-skin it through the renderer.
truth_boundary: Operator surface law. Declares the single-style rule for all creator-facing surfaces and the shared renderer that enforces it. Renders nothing itself; socc_console.py is the live render.
